title: Blucon – no values after reconnection
body:
With the latest nightly the phone receives no readings after reconnecting to Blucon. (The connection status in the status page is „Connected“.) Restarting Blucon manually helps.
The log lists repeatedly: DexCollectionService – Got null pointer trying to set CCCD descriptor

Phone: Nexus 6P
OS phone: Android 8.1.0

comments.body: Tried different settings. Phone receives values from Blucon after reconnection with activated "allow blucon unbonding" setting and enabled Bluetooth Pairing in "Bluetooth Collector Status" page.
